- main:
  - text: Municipal organization
  - heading "Councils, Boards & Committees" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Reference directory for the municipality's formal local special bodies, with mandate, chair role, membership context, scheduled meeting, recent action, and related records.
  - region "Local special bodies summary": 12 Formal bodies 12 Recorded reference meeting dates
  - text: Search councils, boards, and committees
  - textbox "Search councils, boards, and committees"
  - region "Councils, boards & committees register":
    - heading "Councils, boards & committees register" [level=2]
    - text: 12 bodies
    - article:
      - text: LSB-01
      - heading "Municipal Development Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates municipal development planning, investment priorities, and sector participation.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Executive offices, barangay representatives, Sangguniang Bayan representation, and accredited sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-24 · Development investment programming session
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Comprehensive Development Plan · Local Development Investment Program · Annual Investment Program
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed sector submissions for the annual investment program
    - article:
      - text: LSB-02
      - heading "Local School Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor / Schools Division representative"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local support for public basic education and use of the Special Education Fund.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal executive, education representatives, council representation, parent and teacher sectors
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-02 · Special Education Fund program review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local School Board resolutions · Special Education Fund work program
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed current school facility and learning-support priorities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-03
      - heading "Local Health Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local health policy, program priorities, facility concerns, and health-system support.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal Health Officer, health sector representatives, council representation, and partner institutions
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-29 · Health program implementation review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local Health Investment Plan · Health Board resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed health facility readiness and priority public health activities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-04
      - heading "Municipal Peace and Order Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local peace and order planning, inter-agency concerns, and community safety priorities.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Local executive, police, fire, interior and local government, council, and sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-22 · Peace and order situation review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Peace and Order and Public Safety Plan · Council resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Consolidated current barangay and inter-agency coordination items
    - article:
      - text: LSB-05
      - heading "Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery priorities.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Municipal offices, response agencies, utilities, civil society, and sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-18 · Preparedness and response readiness review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local DRRM Plan · Contingency plans · LDRRM Fund investment plan
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed response assets, prepositioning, and barangay readiness
    - article:
      - text: LSB-06
      - heading "Local Council for the Protection of Children" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates child protection policy, prevention, referral, program monitoring, and local council actions.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Social welfare, health, education, police, council, youth, and child-protection stakeholders
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-06 · Child protection program review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local Plan of Action for Children · LCPC resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed prevention activities and referral coordination
    - article:
      - text: LSB-07
      - heading "Municipal Solid Waste Management Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates ecological solid waste management planning, compliance, diversion, and facility concerns.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Environment office, engineering, health, barangays, council, business, and civil society representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-30 · Waste diversion and facility review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Ecological Solid Waste Management Plan · Board resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed barangay waste diversion reporting and recovery facility concerns
    - article:
      - text: LSB-08
      - heading "Municipal Tourism Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor / designated tourism chair"
      - paragraph: Coordinates tourism development, destination management, events, local enterprises, and visitor concerns.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Tourism office, planning, culture, business, transport, accommodation, and community representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-09 · Tourism calendar and site coordination
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local Tourism Development Plan · Tourism Council resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Updated destination readiness and municipal events coordination
    - article:
      - text: LSB-09
      - heading "Municipal Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Council" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Designated municipal FARMC chair"
      - paragraph: Provides local fisheries consultation and coordination for sustainable aquatic resource management.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Fisherfolk representatives, agriculture office, council representation, and coastal stakeholders
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-13 · Fisheries and coastal livelihood review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Municipal fisheries program · FARMC resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed fisherfolk concerns and coastal resource activities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-10
      - heading "Local Housing Board" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor"
      - paragraph: Coordinates local shelter, settlement, relocation, land, and housing-program concerns.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Planning, engineering, assessor, social welfare, council, housing agencies, and community representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-10-16 · Housing and settlement coordination
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Local shelter planning records · Housing Board resolutions
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Consolidated current shelter and settlement coordination items
    - article:
      - text: LSB-11
      - heading "Gender and Development Focal Point System" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Mayor / designated GAD chair"
      - paragraph: Coordinates gender mainstreaming, GAD planning, budgeting, monitoring, and office focal responsibilities.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Office focal persons, planning, budget, social welfare, human resources, and sector representatives
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-25 · GAD plan implementation review
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: GAD Plan and Budget · GAD Accomplishment Report
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed office implementation reports against current GAD activities
    - article:
      - text: LSB-12
      - heading "Local Finance Committee" [level=3]
      - text: "Chair: Municipal Treasurer / committee leadership under applicable rules"
      - paragraph: Coordinates revenue estimates, budget proposals, fiscal position, and local financial management recommendations.
      - term: "Membership:"
      - definition: Treasury, budget, accounting, planning, and other required municipal officials
      - term: "Scheduled:"
      - definition: 2026-09-21 · Fiscal position and budget coordination
      - term: "Documents:"
      - definition: Annual municipal budget · Revenue estimates · Fiscal reports
      - term: "Recent:"
      - definition: Reviewed current revenue, obligation, and budget preparation inputs

        - button "Macro & Spatial" [pressed]
        - button "Hazard & DRRM" [pressed]
        - button "Environment & Coastal" [pressed]
        - button "Infrastructure & Utilities" [pressed]

  - region "Portal Capabilities":
    - paragraph: Internal portal capabilities
    - heading "Portal Capabilities" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Core tools for moving municipal work between offices.
    - text: Available to authorized employees
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "Inter-Office Transactions" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Route requests, endorsements, and actions between offices.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Documents & Memoranda" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Manage official documents, memoranda, records, and correspondence.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Employees & Offices" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Find office and personnel information in one workspace.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Calendar & Coordination" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Coordinate meetings, deadlines, activities, and schedules.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Notifications & Follow-Up" [level=3]

    - link "Employee Login":
